utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hi Grandma! How have you been?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I think it's in the living room, dear.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh, I was actually asking how you've been doing lately. Are you feeling okay?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, dear. Let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I just wanted to make sure you're doing well. Let me know if you need anything too.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm sorry if it seems that way, dear. I'll try to do better. Let's go over it again together.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No need to apologize, Grandma. I just want to make sure we're both on the same page. Let's go over it together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, let's take it step by step. I'm sure we'll get it right this time.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Great! I'm glad we're doing this together. It'll be fun to figure it out step by step.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you for your patience, dear. Let's try it together once more.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're welcome, Grandma! I'm always here to help. Let's get started.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, I can try counting like that. Let's give it another go.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Alright, let's start with the first step. I'll guide you through it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, I'm ready. Let's start counting together.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Great! Let's start with counting to ten slowly, and I'll be right here if you need any help.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I see. I'll try to keep pace with the tick-tocks this time. Thank you for pointing that out.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're doing great, Grandma! Just keep going at your own pace.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, you sound wonderful, dear! Let's play that song together. I'm sure you'll do great on the vocal track.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I'm excited to sing with you. Let's make it a fun duet!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, I'll hold my arms out like you said. Let's see how it goes with the tick-tocking. I'm here to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Great, Grandma! Let's start with the first verse and see how it goes. I'm sure we'll sound amazing together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, dear, I'll make sure to say tick-tock at the right times. Let's try it again together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: You're doing a great job explaining, dear. Let's keep practicing until we get it just right.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I'm really enjoying this. Let's keep going and have fun with it!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, I'll use my third finger. Let's keep going, dear.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: You're really getting the hang of this, dear. I'm so proud of you!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I'm so glad you're proud of me. Let's keep practicing together!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you for being so patient with me, dear. I'm learning a lot from you!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm happy to help, Grandma! It's fun learning together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm sorry, dear, I didn't mean to interrupt you. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No worries, Grandma! I was just saying how much I enjoy our time together.
